title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ‘Le Chéile: Together for an inclusive better world‘ project in Central and West Africa, implemented by Sightsavers Ireland, aims to strengthen education, eye health and governance systems sustainably, so that targeted populations can claim their rights to healthcare and education, and contribute to decisions that affect their lives. The objective is to increase the capacity of education systems in Senegal to provide inclusive education that meets the specific needs and priorities of girls and boys with disabilities. The key activities include strengthening local development plans and budgets, so that councils can mainstream disability and gender into the support that they give to schools, as well as working with school management committees and school inclusion teams.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Strengthened inclusive education systems result in increased access and quality of inclusive education for girls and boys with disabilities in Senegal.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: The overall aim of the project is to ensure that children with disabilities receive quality inclusive education. The project aims to ensure that equal numbers of boys and girls are enrolled.
